attention: formal-module-lifecycle (run with --all, informational because no covered src file changed) reports four violated rules on main: NoOrphanGeneration, LaunchReadsCurrentConfig, ConfigEditsReachProject, NoCrashFromStaleWork. check.mjs exits 0 because each matches its recorded finding (F1 to F4) and counterexample length. These are documented real bugs in ajs project dev (orphan generation after Ctrl+C during async provide, restart reading a cached config, an edit lost during startup, and a restart crashing dev with exit 1). They are not introduced by this PR, but once merged, any PR touching the covered files will FAIL its verdict until they are fixed, because the verdict gates on any violated rule, recorded findings included.
This PR adds the verifier that is judging it. The verdict therefore cannot vouch for the skill's own correctness beyond smoke, map, doors and the two formal checks running cleanly.
